title: WHO Global Health Observatory — Western Pacific Island Country Indicators
description: WHO GHO indicators (life expectancy, NCD mortality, risk factors) for Pacific Island member states of the WHO Western Pacific Region.
notes: WHO data is generally CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO — non-commercial, which conflicts with x402 resale. RESTRICTED so a human decides whether a free/research-tier endpoint is allowed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Monitoring Alliance for NCD Action (MANA) Dashboard
description: SPC-coordinated dashboard tracking Pacific countries' progress on NCD policy and legislation.
notes: Pacific NCD policy-status data (the NCD crisis is the region's leading health burden). Exact dashboard URL and licence to confirm. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) — Pacific
description: Annual national immunisation coverage estimates (DTP3, MCV1/2, etc.) for Pacific Island countries.
notes: Immunisation coverage is a priority Pacific indicator after the 2019 Samoa measles outbreak. Licence terms not confirmed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Data Hub — Health Indicators
description: SPC Pacific Data Hub health indicator datasets, including National Minimum Development Indicators health series.
notes: Regional health indicator catalogue. Licence varies per dataset; not confirmed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Samoa Ministry of Health Annual Health Statistics
description: Samoa Ministry of Health annual reports and health statistics bulletins.
notes: National-level source for Samoa health data (OGIP-adjacent ministry). PDF reports — exercises document extraction. Licence not stated. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.
